name: rebind fresh
code:
a = [1]

name: rebind rows
code:
a = [1]
b = a

name: local rebind
code:
def mk():
    a = [1]
    a = [2]
    return a
x = mk()

name: two calls rows
code:
def mk():
    a = []
    return a
x = mk()
y = mk()
x.append(1)
print(x, y)
